name: Propane and propane mixes
description: Normally straight-chain gaseous paraffinic (saturated) hydrocarbon or compound (C3H8) extracted from natural gas or refinery gas streams. It is a colourless gas that boils at a temperature of -42° Celsius. Cover propane mixes.

name: Butane and butane mixes
description: Normally straight-chain or branch-chain gaseous paraffinic hydrocarbon (C4H10) extracted from natural gas or refinery gas streams. It is a colourless gas that boils at a temperature of -1° Celsius. Covers butane mixes.

name: Ethane
description: Straight-chain gaseous paraffinic (saturated) hydrocarbon (C2H6) extracted predominantly from natural gas streams. It is a colourless gas that boils at a temperature of -88° Celsius.

name: Lease condensate
description: Light liquid hydrocarbons recovered from lease separators or field facilities at associated and non-associated natural gas wells, mostly pentanes and heavier hydrocarbons. Normally enter the crude oil stream after production.

name: Pentanes plus (including plant condensate)

name: Anthracite
description: High rank hard lustrous black coal destined primarily for residential and industrial (as steel making) or commercial applications. It has generally less than 10% volatile matter and a high carbon content (about 90% fixed carbon). Its gross calorific value is equal to or greater than 24,000 kJ/kg, on an ash-free but moist basis.

name: Coking (metallurgical) coal
description: Bituminous coal with a quality that allows the production of a coke suitable to support a blast furnace charge. Its gross calorific value is equal to or greater than 24,000 kJ/kg, on an ash-free but moist basis.

name: Other bituminous coal
description: Other bituminous coal mainly used for steam raising purposes. It is characterized by higher volatile matter than anthracite (more than 10%) and lower carbon content (less than 90% fixed carbon). Its gross calorific value is equal to or greater than 24,000 kJ/kg, on an ash-free but moist basis.

name: Sub-bituminous coal
description: Non-agglomerating coal with a gross calorific value equal to or greater than 20,000 kJ/kg and less than 24,000 kJ/kg, containing more than 31% volatile matter on a dry mineral matter free basis.

name: Lignite
description: Non-agglomerating coal with a gross calorific value less than 20,000 kJ/kg, containing more than 31% volatile matter on a dry mineral matter free basis.

Goods are of varying shapes and sizes. Covers moving by all modes of transportation. May include packing and unpacking. May include declared value coverage.

name: Institutional and other moving services
description: Removing from premises, loading, transporting, unloading and moving into new premises of goods requiring special handling and protection, such as objects of art, antiques, pianos, displays and exhibits when not part of a household or commercial move. Goods are of varying shapes and sizes. Covers moving by all modes of transportation. May include packing and unpacking. May include declared value coverage.

name: Air specialty services
description: Provision of small general-purpose aircraft and helicopters with a crew to perform specialized services.

name: Postal services
description: Delivery of letters and parcels under the terms of a universal service obligation, such as an obligation governing delivery by post offices. May include collect on delivery (C.O.D.) service. May include declared value coverage.

name: Station-to-station transportation of small packages and documents without tracking
description: Transportation of small packages and documents without tracking of each package and document. Service is typically station-to-station but may be door-to-door. Transportation is provided on passenger buses and trains according to published schedules but departure and arrival times are not guaranteed. May include collect on delivery (C.O.D.) service. May include declared value coverage.

name: Same-day courier and messenger services
description: Transportation and delivery, on the same day as pick-up and possibly by a definite time, of small packages and documents, with tracking of each package and document. Delivery on the day or by the specified time may be guaranteed. Small packages usually can be handled by one person without using special equipment. Service is typically door-to-door, although there may be options for the shipper to drop a package off and for the receiver to pick it up, and occasional shippers may have to drop off their packages. Pick-up and delivery outside normal service area or outside normal service hours, and pick-up on demand or on a regular schedule, are covered here. Service may include customs clearance. May include collect on delivery (C.O.D.) service. May include declared value coverage.

name: Next-day courier and messenger services
description: Transportation and delivery, on the first business day or first calendar day following pick-up, and possibly by a definite time, of small packages and documents, with tracking of each package and document. Delivery by the scheduled day or specified time may be guaranteed. Small packages usually can be handled by one person without using special equipment. Service is typically door-to-door, although there may be options for the shipper to drop a package off and for the receiver to pick it up, and occasional shippers may have to drop off their packages. Pick-up and delivery outside normal service area or outside normal service hours, and pick-up on demand or on a regular schedule, are covered here. Service may include customs clearance. May include collect on delivery (C.O.D.) service. May include declared value coverage.

name: Second-day or later courier and messenger services
description: Transportation and delivery, on the second business day or second calendar day following pick-up, or on a later specified day, and possibly by a definite time, of small packages and documents, with tracking of each package and document. Delivery by the scheduled day or specified time may be guaranteed. Small packages usually can be handled by one person without using special equipment. Service is typically door-to-door, although there may be options for the shipper to drop a package off and for the receiver to pick it up, and occasional shippers may have to drop off their packages. Pick-up and delivery outside normal service area or outside normal service hours, and pick-up on demand or on a regular schedule, are covered here. Service may include customs clearance. May include collect on delivery (C.O.D.) service. May include declared value coverage.

name: Neighbourhood delivery of small purchased items
description: Door-to-door transportation and delivery of small purchased and serviced items such as take-out meals, groceries, prescription drugs and dry-cleaned clothes. Service is limited to a specified neighbourhood. Delivery is made immediately after the item is purchased or ordered, or scheduled within a short time. Expected delivery time is made known to the recipient. May include collect on delivery (C.O.D.) service.

name: Urban transit services
description: Passenger transportation operated on a network of regular routes and on regular schedules. Service is centred on an urban area and covers urban and suburban areas and areas from which they draw commuters. Commuter services that primarily carry passengers to and from the urban centre are included. Transportation may involve one or more types of vehicles, such as buses, subways, streetcars, commuter trains and ferries. Passengers are permitted to pay on a per-trip basis, and the fare may be calculated on a zone basis. Covers urban transit services whether paid for by passengers or by contracts.

name: Local limousine services
description: Local passenger transportation by luxury automobile, not operated on regular schedules or routes, and available only by reservation, or without reservation to passengers as they leave an airport or other transportation terminal. In the case of travel from an airport or other transportation terminal, the fee is on the basis of the distance to the destination, calculated on a zone basis; there may be a minimum charge. In other cases, the fee charged is on the basis of the length of time for which the vehicle is reserved; there is normally a minimum length of time and/or a minimum tariff. The vehicle and driver are available to make a series of trips as directed by the customer during the period for which the vehicle has been reserved.

name: Local taxi services
description: Passenger transportation by automobile, not operated on regular schedules or routes, and available on demand. The fee charged to passengers is on the basis of distance travelled.

name: Dispatch services for taxi and ridesharing, including online
description: Dispatch services for taxi and ridesharing, including online.

name: Interurban and rural bus passenger transportation services
description: Long distance passenger transportation by road, over fixed routes on a regular schedule. Long distance transportation is generally between metropolitan areas. Service is either part of an interurban network and connecting services to other destinations are available or service is intended to serve a particular destination, and is not designed to connect to a network of interurban service. Covers charges for incidental transportation of passenger baggage.

name: School bus services
description: Transportation of students between home and school on a regular basis. Service is operated on regular routes and schedules that are designed to accommodate the home locations of individual passengers. The vehicles used are typically buses but may include smaller vehicles such as vans and cars, and may include vehicles accessible to people using wheelchairs and other mobility aids. Passengers are not charged a per-trip fee. Covers school bus services whether paid for by passengers or by contracts.

name: Long distance passenger transportation by chartered bus
description: Long distance passenger transportation for a specific occasion by road vehicles with sufficient interior height for a person to stand, typically buses but not limousines or taxis, with driver. Service is not operated on regular schedules or routes, and is available only by reservation of the entire vehicle, for which a fee is charged to the party who makes the reservation. The party who makes the reservation may or may not charge the passengers an explicit fee for the transportation. Covers use of vehicles that are accessible to passengers using wheelchairs and other mobility aids.

name: Local passenger transportation by chartered bus
description: Local passenger transportation for a specific occasion by road vehicles with sufficient interior height for a person to stand, typically buses but not limousines or taxis, with driver. Service is not operated on regular schedules or routes, and is available only by reservation of the entire vehicle, for which a fee is charged to the party who makes the reservation. The party who makes the reservation may or may not charge the passengers an explicit fee for the transportation. Covers use of vehicles that are accessible to passengers using wheelchairs and other mobility aids.

name: Other long distance passenger transportation services by road (except fixed route)
description: Long distance passenger transportation by luxury automobile, not operated on regular schedules or routes, and available only by reservation. The operator carries as many parties having similar origins or destinations as can be accommodated on each trip.

name: Shuttle services
description: Passenger transportation operated on regular routes and on regular schedules or on regular routes on an unscheduled but frequent basis. Service is typically between a limited number of pick-up and drop-off points, with no local service for other points along the route; or on a circular route with frequent stops. The service is not part of a network. As many passengers as can be accommodated are carried on a first-come first-served basis. Passengers may or may not be charged a per-trip fee. Covers shuttle service whether paid for by passengers or by contracts.

name: Other local fixed route passenger transportation services by road
description: Local fixed route passenger transportation service by road except urban transit service, transportation of students between home and school on a regular basis, and shuttle service. Covers employee transportation to work arranged by the employer and operated on regular routes and schedules. Vehicles used are typically buses but may be smaller vehicles such as vans and cars, and may be accessible to people using wheelchairs and other mobility aids. Passengers are not charged a per-trip fee. Covers employee transportation to work whether paid for by passengers or by contracts. Carpool transportation is provided by arranging and administering pools and providing a vehicle to members of each pool in exchange for a monthly fee to cover operating costs. One or more pool members must act as driver.

name: Special needs urban transit services
description: Transportation of passengers who have physical or cognitive impairments that make them unable to use regular urban transit. Transportation is by shared vans, minibuses or automobiles, is not operated on regular schedules or routes, and is available only to registered passengers by reservation. Passengers are transported to and from their individual homes, workplaces and other locations. Passengers are charged a per-trip fee. Covers special needs urban transit service whether paid for by passengers or by contracts.

name: Local shared-ride passenger transportation services
description: Local shared-ride service, that is, local shared passenger transportation operated on request, typically between an airport and homes, offices or hotels specified by passengers. The operator carries as many parties having similar origins or destinations as can be accommodated on each trip.

name: Rental of passenger automobiles and light vans, with operator
description: Rental or operating leasing services of passenger automobiles and light vans with operator or driver, that is, chauffeur-driven car-hire services, wherever delivered, generally supplied on a time basis to a limited number of passengers and frequently involving transportation to more than one destination.

name: Rental of buses and coaches, with operator
description: Rental or operating leasing services of buses or coaches with operator or driver for a period of time, not generally dependent on distance. The renter defines how and when the vehicles will be operated, determining schedules, routes, and other operational considerations.

name: Passenger rail transportation services, business class
description: Interurban transportation of passengers by rail, with premium-quality amenities, without sleeping facilities. The fare is not subject to advance purchase requirements or restrictions on exchanges or refunds. Covers the transport of accompanying luggage and other items as well as sales to passengers and bulk purchases by tour operators of seats for resale; exclusive and non-exclusive car usage; and scheduled and non-scheduled services. May include a segment where transportation is by bus. Covers service paid for with a ticket or voucher from a book of tickets, or with a train pass.

name: Passenger rail transportation services, economy/discounted economy classes
description: Interurban transportation of passengers by rail, with standard-quality amenities, without sleeping facilities. Food and beverages are available at an extra charge. Covers both economy and discounted economy classes; the latter offers the same amenities as the economy class but contains restrictions such as advance purchase and penalty charges for exchanges and refunds. Covers the transport of accompanying luggage and other items as well as sales to passengers and bulk purchases by tour operators of seats for resale; exclusive and non-exclusive car usage; and scheduled and non-scheduled services. May include a segment where transportation is by bus. Covers service paid for with a ticket or voucher from a book of tickets, or with a train pass.

name: Passenger rail transportation services, sleeper class

Services include implementing a bundle of marketing or advertising methods, such as telemarketing, distribution of advertising materials and advertising specialties, other than by mail, direct mail, product demonstrations and display lettering. Generally, the direct advertising service bundle is sold as a package and provides financial gain for the client.

name: Full service advertising campaigns
description: Provision of all services required to create a comprehensive advertising campaign and place the resulting advertisements in media. Services include a bundle of advertising services with some or all creative and productive services for advertisements; and planning, buying of time and space and research media services. Generally, the advertising campaign service bundle is sold as a package and provides financial gain for the client.

name: Advertising creative services

name: Public relations services

name: Advertising services, n.e.c.

name: Studio recording services

name: Live sound recording services
description: Sound recording of live events.

name: Support services for sound recording
description: Support services used in the production of sound recordings.

name: Administration of copyrights for others

name: Contract production of feature films

name: Contract production of television programs
description: Production, on contract, of television programs.

name: Contract production of commercials
description: Production, on contract, of commercials.

name: Contract production of corporate/industry videos
description: Production, on contract, of scripted videos for companies, corporations and similar organizations.

name: Contract production of music videos

name: Contract production of educational videos

name: Contract production of videos for government

name: Contract production of other videos and audiovisual works, n.e.c.

name: Pre-production services for audiovisual works
description: Preparatory services for the production of audiovisual works.

name: Support services for audiovisual works during production
description: Technical and artistic support services during the production of an audiovisual work, including for live events.

name: Editing services for audiovisual works
description: Organizing and arranging the visual and audio aspects of an audiovisual work after the principal photography or main shooting has occurred.

name: Transfer services for audiovisual works
description: Transferring of an audiovisual work from one format to another.

name: Colour correction services and digital restoration services for audiovisual works
description: Adding, modifying, or excluding colour from an audiovisual work and restoring audiovisual works by using digital techniques.

name: Visual effects and animation services for audiovisual works
description: Adding visual effects to audiovisual works and creating animations for audiovisual works.

name: Captioning, titling and subtitling services for audiovisual works
description: Adding open and close captions, titles and subtitles to an audiovisual work.

name: DVD authoring services
description: Creating user menus, chapter points and other functionalities to enable a DVD video to play on a DVD player.

name: Other post-production services for audiovisual works
description: Other post-production services for audiovisual works.

name: Motion picture film laboratory services
description: Motion picture film laboratory services.

name: Duplication and copying (except large-run) services for audiovisual works, digital and video
description: Creating limited high-quality reproductions of the master of an audiovisual work and small-run reproductions of audiovisual works in a variety of formats.

description: Licences for the use of intellectual property from newspapers, periodicals and books to generate revenues.

name: Licensing of rights for commercial use of databases, directories and mailing lists
description: Licences for the use of intellectual property from databases, directories and mailing lists to generate revenues.

name: Licensing of rights for commercial use of stock photos and other literary and artistic works (except software)
description: Licences for the use of intellectual property from stock photos and literary and artistic works, except software, newspapers, periodicals, books, databases, directories and mailing lists, to generate revenues.

name: Other sporting event media rights

name: Affiliation payments for the distribution of television channels
description: Rights (affiliation payments) for the distribution of a television channel to end users.

name: Affiliation payments for the distribution of audio channels
description: Rights (affiliation payments) for the distribution of an audio channel to end users.

name: Fixed wholesale telecommunications services (except Internet access)
description: Provision of a fixed telecommunications service or facility by a telecommunications service provider to a provider of retail fixed telecommunications services. The purchaser may resell the service or facility to another entity, or use the service or facility to support the services it bills.

name: Fixed wholesale Internet access services
description: Provision of fixed Internet access and transport services by a telecommunications service provider to a provider of fixed retail Internet access services.

name: Mobile wholesale telecommunications services
description: Provision of a mobile telecommunications service or facility by a wireless telecommunications service provider to another to exchange traffic and extend service coverage area.

name: Fixed local and access telecommunications services (except Internet access), at retail
description: A landline-based telephone service that allows end users to make calls within a defined local area and provides access to a long distance network of the customer's choice.

name: Fixed long distance telecommunications services (except Internet access), at retail
description: A landline-based telephone service allowing end users to make calls outside a local calling area.

name: Data transmission services
description: Telecommunications services making use of data protocols to transmit data over a public network.

name: Private network services
description: Telecommunications network segments for the exclusive use of the client on which no control or signalling is performed by the telecommunications service provider.

name: Dial-up Internet access services
description: Provision of fixed connections to the Internet to end users at download speeds not exceeding 64 Kbps. Dial-up Internet access is one of the oldest forms of Internet access technology. It is also referred to as low or narrowband speed Internet access. Narrowband is generally regarded as a category including any connection with a transmission or download speed of up to 1.5 Mbps.

name: Fixed high-speed Internet access services, residential
description: Provision of fixed connections to the Internet to residential end users at download speeds generally greater than 256 Kbps. High-speed Internet is also referred to as broadband Internet, with fixed line types such as cable, digital subscriber line (DSL), terrestrial wireless access, direct-to-home satellite access, and fibre optic services. Even though the lowest speed limit for high-speed Internet is set to 256 Kbps in several countries, broadband is generally regarded as a category including any connection with a transmission or download speed of 1.5 Mbps or greater. Connection with download speed from 256 Kbps up to 1.5 Mbps is sometimes referred to as

name: Fixed high-speed Internet access services, non-residential
description: Provision of fixed connections to the Internet to non-residential or business end users at download speeds greater than 256 Kbps. High-speed Internet is also referred to as broadband Internet, with fixed line types such as cable, digital subscriber line (DSL), terrestrial wireless access, direct-to-home satellite access, and fibre optic services. Even though the lowest speed limit for high-speed Internet is set to 256 Kbps in several countries, broadband is generally regarded as a category including any connection with a transmission or download speed of 1.5 Mbps or greater. Connection with download speed from 256 Kbps up to 1.5 Mbps is sometimes referred to as

name: Mobile local and access telecommunications services, at retail
description: A wireless-based telecommunications service that allows end users to make and receive calls within a defined local area and provides access to a long distance network of the customer's choice. Mobile cell phone plans typically bundle voice and text messaging.

name: Mobile long distance telecommunications services, at retail
description: Wireless based telecommunications service allowing end users to make calls outside a local calling area.

name: Mobile data services
description: A service plan providing end users mobile access to text and multimedia messaging, along with access to the Internet through the cellular network. This service is also referred as

name: Roaming services
description: A service that allows a cell phone subscriber to use his or her mobile device while in the service area of another service provider.

name: Basic television programming packages (except online streaming)
description: Providing a basic package of movie and television programming services, basically to a fixed device, except using online streaming, for a monthly subscription fee. Basic packages are any first level programming package that must be purchased before being able to purchase additional programming packages. The basic programming packages are delivered using traditional over-the-air (OTA), cable and satellite television.

name: Online streaming of basic programming packages
description: Providing a basic package of movie and television programming services over the Internet, to a fixed or mobile device, using online streaming, for a monthly subscription fee. Basic packages are any first level programming package that must be purchased before being able to purchase additional programming packages.

name: Discretionary programming packages (except online streaming)
description: Providing movie and television programming services, in addition to those included in a basic package, for an additional monthly subscription fee, generally to a fixed device, except using online streaming. This programming service comprises bundles of channels or à la carte channels. The discretionary television programming packages are delivered using traditional cable and satellite television.

name: Online streaming of discretionary programming packages
description: Providing movie and television programming services over the Internet, in addition to those included in a basic package, for an additional monthly subscription fee, to a fixed or mobile device, using online streaming. This programming service comprises bundles of channels or à la carte channels.

name: Pay-per-view services (except online streaming)
description: Providing services which enable subscribers to television programming packages, to watch a specific program (movie or event) at the same broadcast time, generally at a fixed device, for an additional fee, except using online streaming. The pay-per-view services are delivered using traditional cable and satellite television.

name: Online streaming of pay-per-view programs
description: Providing services over the Internet which enable subscribers to television programming packages, to watch a specific program (movie or event) at the same broadcast time, on a fixed or mobile device, using online streaming, for an additional fee.

name: Television, movie and video on demand (except online streaming)
description: Providing pay television, movie and other video on demand services (except per-pay-view), generally via fixed devices, except using online streaming. Subscribers or viewers to/of video on demand are allowed to choose and watch broadcasts at any time, usually for a one time fee paid for each individual video that is on demand (transactional video on demand). Video on demand services are delivered using traditional cable and satellite television.

name: Online on demand streaming of television, movie and video
description: Providing pay television, movie and other video on demand services (except pay-per-view) over the Internet, via fixed or mobile devices, using online streaming. Subscribers or viewers to/of video on demand are allowed to choose and watch broadcasts at any time, usually for a monthly or annual subscription fee (subscription video on demand) to have unlimited access to television programs, movies and any other types of videos during the time covered by the subscription.

name: Satellite radio services
description: Pay satellite radio services.

name: Online audio streaming services
description: Providing programming services (including self-programming), over the Internet, that comprise a single payment (fee) or a subscription, to a selection of radio shows, music and other audio recordings, streamed to fixed and mobile devices (Internet audio services). Subscribers are allowed to choose and stream contents at any time during the time covered by the payment or subscription.

name: Online gaming services (except gambling)
description: Providing various games to be played online, on a subscription or single payment (fee) basis, except gambling. The games are streamed over the Internet to fixed and mobile devices.

name: Installation services for connections to broadcasting distribution networks
description: Providing installation of cables on the customer premises and/or installing outlets to connect to the program or broadcasting distribution networks.

name: Website hosting services
description: Services of providing the infrastructure to host a customer's website and related files in a location that provides connection to the Internet or make their website accessible via the World Wide Web.

name: Domain names registration services
description: Services of providing the registration of a domain name for a customer, by certified registrars and authorized resellers or affiliates.

name: Application service provisioning (except software as a service, on cloud)
description: Provision of leased software applications from a centralized, hosted, and managed computing environment, customized to the needs of each clients, except software as a service (SaaS), cloud-based or on demand.

name: Software as a service, on cloud
description: Provision of rented or leased software applications over the Internet, from a centralized, Internet-hosted, and managed cloud computing multi tenant environment, where all clients can use the same application, on demand, commonly (not exclusively) on a monthly or an annual fee basis. No installation of the application software is needed for the client.

name: Business process management services
description: Services that analyze the way a business process is conducted, and identifies improvements that can be made by integrating existing and new software services, in order to improve information flows and increase automation of the process.

name: Information technology (IT) infrastructure co-location services (except telecommunications facilities)
description: Information technology (IT) infrastructure co-location services, except telecommunications facilities, which provide storage capacity and Internet connections for rental to multiple retail clients.

name: Data storage infrastructure provisioning services
description: Services of providing the infrastructure and the management or administration of the storage and back-up of data.

name: Data management infrastructure provisioning services
description: Services of providing the infrastructure and on-going management and administration of data as an organizational resource.

name: Video and audio streaming infrastructure provisioning services
description: Services of providing the infrastructure for sending audio and video data over the Internet or providing services to support video and audio streaming over the Internet.

name: Infrastructure as a service (except data storage infrastructure provisioning)
description: Infrastructure as a service (except data storage infrastructure provisioning).

name: Platform as a service
description: Platform as a service (PaaS), or application platform as a service (aPaaS), refers to a category of cloud computing services that allows customers to provision, run, and manage a modular bundle of one or more applications and based on IT infrastructure as a service.

name: Other information technology (IT) infrastructure provisioning services, n.e.c.
description: Other information technology (IT) infrastructure provisioning services, n.e.c.

name: Network management services
description: Services of managing and monitoring communication networks and connected hardware to diagnose networking problems and gather capacity and usage statistics for the administration and fine-tuning of network traffic.

name: Computer systems management services
description: Providing day-to-day management and operation of a client's computer system.

name: Imaging and other data capture services
description: Services of converting paper documents into digital or other machine-readable formats. These services generally involve the following components: document preparation; scanning, optical character recognition, and other data capture activities; and the delivery or output of the information captured into a database or a physical medium.

name: Data conversion and migration services
description: Services of moving data from one storage device to another or from one file format to another.

name: Lending library services
description: Providing access to library resources.

name: Archival institution services
description: Providing access to archives, and other archive-related services.

name: Information services, n.e.c.
description: Collecting, disseminating or providing access to information, n.e.c.

name: Regulation of securities markets
description: Services provided by central banks, other government agencies, and self-regulatory bodies (such as stock exchanges) to regulate securities markets and the participants in securities markets.

name: Regulation of credit markets
description: Services provided by central banks, other government agencies, and self-regulatory bodies to regulate credit markets and the participants in credit markets.

name: Regulation of insurance markets
description: Services provided by central banks, other government agencies, and self-regulatory bodies to regulate insurance markets and the participants in insurance markets.

name: Deposit account service packages
description: Bundled services related to deposit accounts (cheques, account statements, automated banking machine (ATM) transactions, etc.) provided for a flat fee, usually paid monthly. Non-deposit services, such as traveller's cheques, may be included in deposit account service packages.

name: Separately-priced deposit account products
description: Services related to deposit accounts, sold on an individual basis.

name: Cash handling and management products
description: Specialized deposit account and cash management services provided to businesses and government.

name: Payment document products
description: Issuing documents that can be used as payment instruments.

name: Foreign currency exchange at retail
description: Exchanging the currency of one country for that of another in small amounts, for a fee or commission.

name: Loans to businesses
description: Loans to businesses. Loans represent the direct lending of funds under legal contract, either unsecured or secured by the assets being financed or by other assets, but without the exchange or the use of securities as collateral.

name: Loans to government
description: Loans to government.

name: Residential mortgage loans
description: Mortgage loans provided to owner-occupiers, secured by residential real property.

name: Home equity loans
description: Loans and lines of credit secured by the equity of a borrower's residence.

name: Secured home loans (except residential mortgage and home equity loans) to households
description: Secured or guaranteed home loans to households, except residential mortgage and home equity loans.

name: Vehicle loans to households
description: Loans to households for purchasing automobiles and other vehicles, secured by the vehicle.

name: Other secured consumer loans to households, n.e.c.
description: Other secured loans to households, n.e.c.

name: Unsecured loans to households
description: Loans and lines of credit, not secured by collateral, for personal uses.

name: Credit card cardholder products for businesses and government
description: Provision of a revolving line of credit to business and government holders of credit cards, allowing them to purchase goods and services from merchants who accept their card. Credit granted through credit cards may be unsecured, or secured by a deposit held by the card issuer.

name: Credit card cardholder products to consumers
description: Provision of a revolving line of credit to consumer holders of credit cards, allowing them to purchase goods and services from merchants who accept their card. Credit granted through credit cards may be unsecured, or secured by a deposit held by the card issuer.

name: Credit card merchant products
description: Credit card transaction processing services provided by processors and banks to merchant account holders.

name: Credit card association products
description: Services provided by credit card associations to issuing banks.

name: Factoring
description: Financing provided to a business from the sale of its accounts receivable to a third party, known as a factor. Normally, the factor assumes the full risk of collection, including credit losses.

name: Financial leasing, motor vehicles
description: Motor vehicle leases in which the lessor is providing a financial service to enable the lessee to enjoy the benefits of ownership of the leased asset. A lessee has the option of purchasing the motor vehicle after the lease term has been completed, at an agreed price. With a finance lease the motor vehicle appears on the lessee's balance sheet, as it is viewed as a purchase.

name: Financial leasing (except motor vehicles)
description: Leases (except for motor vehicles) in which the lessor is providing a financial service to enable the lessee to enjoy the benefits of ownership of the leased asset. A lessee has the option of purchasing the machinery and equipment after the lease term has been completed, at an agreed price. With a finance lease the equipment appears on the lessee's balance sheet, as it is viewed as a purchase.

name: Sales financing to businesses
description: Providing credit by means of conditional sales contracts for purchases by businesses.

name: Sales financing to consumers
description: Providing credit by means of conditional sales contracts for purchases by consumers.

name: Securities lending
description: Collateralized lending of securities, to be returned on a specific date or on demand, paid for by fees based on the value of the loaned securities.

name: Repurchase agreements
description: The sale of a security (often Treasury Bills) to a counterparty for cash with an agreement to repurchase it at a fixed price on a specified future date.

name: Other credit financing products, n.e.c.
description: Provision of credit by means other than loans, credit cards, factoring, leasing, instalment credit products, and financing related to securities lending and repurchase agreements.

name: Securities origination products
description: Assisting the issuers of securities (businesses and government) in creating their securities and in having them distributed to the investing public. The service may involve advising the issuer; purchasing securities from the issuer and selling them (underwriting); or acting as an agent in marketing the securities.

name: Brokering and dealing products, negotiable certificates of deposit
description: Brokering and dealing negotiable certificates of deposit, with a term of one year or less.

name: Brokering and dealing products, commercial paper issued by financial institutions
description: Brokering and dealing commercial paper issued by financial institutions, with a term of one year or less.

name: Brokering and dealing products, commercial paper issued by non-financial institutions
description: Brokering and dealing commercial paper issued by non-financial institutions, with a term of one year or less.

name: Brokering and dealing products, bankers' acceptances
description: Brokering and dealing bankers' acceptances, with a term of one year or less.

name: Brokering and dealing products, Treasury bills
description: Brokering and dealing Treasury bills, with a term of one year or less.

name: Brokering and dealing products, other money market instruments
description: Brokering and dealing money market instruments other than commercial paper, bankers' acceptances, negotiable certificates of deposit, or Treasury bills.

name: Brokering and dealing products, corporate bonds and asset-backed securities
description: Brokering and dealing medium- and long-term corporate notes and bonds, and asset-backed securities.

name: Brokering and dealing products, national government notes and bonds
description: Brokering and dealing medium- and long-term bonds issued by the Government of Canada.

name: Brokering and dealing products, provincial and local government notes and bonds
description: Brokering and dealing medium- and long-term bonds issued by provincial and local governments.

name: Brokering and dealing products, foreign government notes and bonds
description: Brokering and dealing notes and bonds issued by foreign governments.

name: Brokering and dealing of equities
description: Brokering and dealing equity securities.

name: Brokering and dealing products, futures contracts, exchange-traded
description: Brokering and dealing futures contracts on exchanges.

name: Brokering and dealing products, option contracts, exchange-traded
description: Brokering and dealing option contracts on exchanges.

name: Brokering and dealing products, forward contracts, traded over-the-counter
description: Brokering and dealing forward contracts over-the-counter.

name: Brokering and dealing products, swaps, traded over-the-counter
description: Brokering and dealing swap contracts over-the-counter.

name: Brokering and dealing products, option contracts, traded over-the-counter
description: Brokering and dealing option contracts over-the-counter.

name: Brokering and dealing products, other derivatives contracts, traded over-the-counter
description: Brokering and dealing derivative contracts, other than forward, swap or option contracts, over-the-counter.

name: Foreign currency wholesale brokering and dealing
description: Brokering and dealing foreign currencies, on a wholesale basis.

name: Brokering and dealing of investment company securities
description: Brokering and dealing investment company securities.

name: Brokerage or dealing services of cryptocurrency (virtual currency)
description: Brokerage or dealing services of cryptocurrency (virtual currency).

name: Brokering and dealing of other financial instruments
description: Brokering and dealing of other financial instruments.

name: Brokerage correspondent products
description: Service consisting of one broker-dealer carrying out trades on behalf of another, where the first broker-dealer has access to a particular securities exchange and the other does not.

name: Personal trust services
description: Services to establish and administer trusts, under which a trustee holds legal title to property belonging to another, for the benefit of a beneficiary. Trusts are defined by an agreement, contract, declaration in a will, or order of a court.

name: Personal financial planning and investment management services
description: Financial planning and investment management services for individuals.

name: Trust services for businesses, institutions (except unincorporated), and governments
description: Services to establish and administer trusts for businesses, institutions (except unincorporated), and governments.

name: Financial planning and investment management services for businesses, institutions (except unincorporated), and governments
description: Financial planning and investment management services for businesses, institutions (except unincorporated), and governments.

name: Tax planning and consulting services for businesses (except unincorporated) and governments
description: Tax planning and consulting services for businesses (except unincorporated) and governments.

name: Payment clearing and settlement services
description: Clearing and settling payments for financial transactions other than trades of securities and commodity contracts.

name: Security and commodity contract trade execution, clearing and settlement services
description: Executing, clearing and settling trades of securities and commodity contracts and other financial instruments.

name: Services of access to security and commodity contract trade execution and clearing systems
description: Providing broker-dealers with access to securities or commodity contract trading systems, whether live floor exchanges or electronic systems.

name: Security and commodity contract exchange and clearing house listing services
description: Listing securities and other financial instruments on trading, clearing and settlement systems.

name: Other management of financial market and clearing services
description: Providing support services for trading, clearing and settling securities and commodities contracts and financial payments, n.e.c.

name: Automated clearing house services
description: Automated funds credit and debit clearing and settlement services.

name: Loan servicing
description: Loan servicing entails the processing of payments of principal and interest, the maintenance of associated accounts such as escrow accounts for the payment of taxes and insurance, and the provision of loan information.

name: Automated banking machine (ABM) operation products
description: Use of automated banking machines (ABMs) not associated with the user's financial institution.

name: Other miscellaneous products supporting financial services
description: Products supporting financial services, n.e.c.

name: Pension and annuity products
description: Underwriting services of plans which provide income payments at regular intervals to individuals or members of groups. Plans may require a single contribution or a series of contributions; may be compulsory or optional; may have nominal benefits determined in advance or dependent on the market value of aspects supporting the plan; and, if related to employment, may or may not be portable with a change in employment. The duration of the period during which benefits are paid may be fixed in terms of a minimum or maximum; there may or may not be survivors' benefits.

name: Life insurance products
description: Underwriting services of insurance policies which provide for the payment of claims to beneficiaries contingent upon the death of the insured individual or upon the maturation of the policy. Policies may provide pure protection or may also contain a savings component. Policies may cover individuals or members of groups.

name: Health insurance products
description: Underwriting services of insurance policies which provide protection for specified expenses not covered by government health insurance programs, as well as underwriting services of insurance policies which provide periodic payments when the insured is unable to work as a result of a disability due to illness or injury.

name: Accident insurance products
description: Underwriting services of insurance policies which provide accidental death and dismemberment insurance, that is, payment in the event that an accident results in death or specified injuries.

name: Vehicle insurance products
description: Underwriting property and casualty insurance policies related to the operation of personal or commercial vehicles. These policies provide financial protection against the loss or damage to property, or personal injury.

name: Homeowners multi-peril property insurance products
description: Underwriting homeowners multi-peril property insurance policies. These policies provide financial protection against the loss or damage to property.

name: Commercial and industrial multi-peril property insurance products
description: Underwriting commercial and industrial multi-peril property insurance policies. These policies provide financial protection against the loss or damage to property.

name: Other property insurance products (except multi-peril and vehicle)
description: Underwriting property insurance policies, except multi-peril and those related to the operation of vehicles. These policies provide financial protection against the loss or damage to property.

name: Surety bonds and related products
description: Sale of surety and related products, in which one party guarantees the performance of a second party vis-à-vis another, thereby establishing a three-party relationship. The three parties are the principal (the party that undertakes the obligation), the surety (the party that guarantees that the obligation will be performed), and the obligee (the party that receives the benefit of the bond if the principal fails to meet the obligation).

name: Product liability insurance products
description: Underwriting insurance policies that insure against financial loss arising from legal liability for harm caused by a product sold by the policyholder.

name: Other general liability insurance products
description: Underwriting insurance policies that insure against financial loss arising from legal liability, except product liability.

name: Travel insurance products
description: Underwriting insurance policies that protect travellers against travel-related expenses.

name: Other miscellaneous direct insurance products
description: Underwriting insurance policies that protect the insured from risks, n.e.c.

name: Life, health and annuity reinsurance products
description: Reinsurance services for life and health insurance, and for annuities.

name: Surety bonds and related reinsurance products
description: Reinsurance services for surety bonds.

name: Property and casualty reinsurance products
description: Reinsurance services for property and casualty insurance policies.

name: Other reinsurance products
description: Reinsurance services, n.e.c.

name: Insurance brokerage and agency services
description: Serving as an agent or broker in selling insurance policies or reinsurance contracts.

name: Claims adjustment services
description: Determining the amount, if any, to be paid to an insurance policyholder making a claim under the policy.

name: Insurance consulting services
description: Insurance and actuarial consulting services.

name: Other services related to insurance
description: Services that support the underwriting and reinsuring of insurance policies, n.e.c.

name: Rental of land for residential use
description: Rental or leasing of land for residential use.

name: Rental of residential space in houses, for use as principal residence
description: Rental or leasing of space in houses, for use as the principal residence of a household. Houses are accommodation units in which each housing unit is separated from its neighbours by a ground-to-roof wall, with no units either above or below. May include additional facilities, such as parking and recreational amenities.

name: Rental of residential space in apartment buildings, for use as principal residence
description: Rental or leasing of space or units in apartment buildings and similar housing units, for use as the principal residence of a household. These are units in which each housing unit is not separated from its neighbours by a ground-to-roof wall, and/or adjoins units constructed above or below. May include additional facilities, such as parking and recreational amenities.

name: Rental of residential space, for use as principal residence, n.e.c.
description: Rental or leasing of space for use as the principal residence of a household, except in houses, apartments buildings and similar housing units.

name: Rooming and boarding services
description: Rental or leasing of space for use as the principal residence of a tenant in rooming and boarding houses. May include additional services, such as housekeeping, meal and laundry services.

name: Rental of land for non-residential use
description: Rental or leasing of land for non-residential use.

name: Rental of office and professional space
description: Rental or leasing of buildings or other space for office and professional use.

name: Rental of commercial space
description: Rental or leasing of buildings or other space for commercial use.

name: Rental of industrial space
description: Rental or leasing of buildings or other space for use in manufacturing, research, storage, distribution and similar industrial activities.

name: Rental of space in mini-warehouses and self-storage units
description: Rental of storage space which can be accessed directly by the renter.

name: Rental of space for meetings, conventions, and similar short-term business use
description: Rental of space for meetings, conventions, and similar short-term business use.

name: Rental of space for weddings, banquets, parties, and similar short-term social use

description: Services provided by provincial and territorial governments in maintaining law and order by means of operating police forces.

name: Provincial and territorial fire-fighting services
description: Services provided by provincial and territorial governments with respect to the prevention, investigation and extinction of fires.

name: Provincial and territorial regulatory services
description: General protection services of individuals, singly or in groups, against negligence, exploitation or abuse, provided by provincial and territorial governments.

name: Other provincial and territorial protective services
description: Provincial and territorial government services of responding to large-scale emergencies and disasters.

name: Provincial and territorial labour and employment services
description: Services of provincial and territorial governments in labour market research and matters pertaining to employer-employee relations, including the promotion of improved working conditions and the provision of arbitration and conciliation services in collective bargaining.

name: Other provincial and territorial government public administration services
description: Services provided by provincial and territorial governments with respect to executive and legislative activities; fiscal and related policies and the administration of the public debt; assessing, levying and collecting taxes; conducting relations with other levels of government; and the administration of provincial and territorial government programs.

name: Municipal and other local courts of law services
description: Municipal and other local governments services of rendering judgements and interpreting the law, including the arbitration of civil actions.

name: Municipal and other local correctional services
description: Incarceration and rehabilitation services of jails, and operation of other detention establishments, by municipal and other local governments.

name: Municipal and other local police services
description: Services provided by municipal and other local governments in maintaining law and order by means of operating police forces.

name: Municipal and other local fire-fighting services
description: Services provided by municipal and other local governments with respect to the prevention, investigation and extinction of fires.

name: Municipal and other local regulatory services
description: General protection services of individuals, singly or in groups, against negligence, exploitation or abuse, provided by municipal and other local governments.

name: Municipal and other local protective services, n.e.c.
description: Municipal services and services of other local governments involved in responding to large-scale emergencies and disasters.

name: Municipal and other local public administration services, n.e.c.
description: Services provided by municipal and other local governments with respect to executive and legislative activities; planning; fiscal and related policies and the administration of the public debt; assessing, levying and collecting taxes; conducting relations with other levels of government; and the administration of municipal and other local government programs.

name: Indigenous public administration services
description: Range of services provided by Indigenous governments to their constituents, services that would otherwise be provided by federal, provincial/territorial or municipal levels of governments.

name: International and other extra-territorial public administration services
description: Governmental services provided by foreign governments in Canada.
